versions.changelog:
- Initial release of TikTok automation skill using Playwright on TikTok Studio web.
- Automates posting videos and photo posts with TikTok music, caption editing, and deleting posts—no official API or paid services needed.
- Supports scheduled posting via cron with persistent sessions after QR login.
- Robust error handling for posting flows, caption editing, and photo/music selection.
- Designed to prevent duplicate posts and allow parallel manual posting by owner.
